speaker: Mr Desmond Choo
text: asked the Minister for Trade and Industry in view of the United States-imposed restrictions on sales of semiconductor products to China from 7 October 2022 (a) what has been the impact on the semiconductor industry in Singapore; and (b) whether, and, if so, how is the Ministry supporting the industry in building up its resilience to geopolitical tensions.

speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
text: Collectively, these will enhance Singapore’s relevance in global semiconductor supply chains and strengthen our resilience against any shocks.

speaker: Mr Desmond Choo (Tampines)
text: The first is: does the Ministry have at least an estimation of how much of our semiconductor industry is exposed to this new set of regulations from the US and, therefore, affecting the economic performance of the industry?

speaker: Mr Desmond Choo (Tampines)
text: Second, in terms of the various free trade agreements that we have in place, how much have they allowed us and the semiconductor companies situated here to be able to navigate the changing landscape for the semiconductor industry?

speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
text: As I mentioned in my main reply, Singapore is a part of the global supply chain of the semiconductor industry.

speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
text: It is equally possible that the US could be contemplating additional steps that may further reshape or affect the technology supply chains.

speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
text: Our companies will be affected in certain ways, given that we are part of this global semiconductor supply chain.

speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
text: Against this backdrop, it is thus more important that we uphold and reiterate our position as a stable, trusted and well-connected hub and location for businesses, including the semiconductor businesses.

speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
text: Earlier this week, together with Deputy Prime Minister Heng Swee Keat, we were at ITAP Asia where many of the semiconductor companies were there.

speaker: Mr Speaker
text: [Pursuant to Standing Order No 22(3), Written Answers to Question Nos 20, 22-27, 29-55 and 57-65 on the Order Paper are reproduced in the Appendix.

speaker: Mr Speaker
text: The remaining Questions have been postponed to a later Sitting of Parliament or withdrawn.]
